core: grid container and direct grid items
rows, columns, tracks, lines, cells, and areas

claims.claim: A grid container establishes a two-dimensional grid formatting context and its direct children are grid items.
A grid track is a row or column between adjacent grid lines, a cell is bounded by adjacent row and column lines, and a grid area is a rectangular set of cells.
grid-column and grid-row can place an item by lines; a placement from line 1 to line 3 spans two tracks.
Named grid areas declared by grid-template-areas must form rectangles and describe layout rather than HTML semantics.
fr units share leftover space among flexible tracks, while repeat() abbreviates repeated track patterns and minmax() specifies a track sizing range.
For an 800px grid with tracks 160px 1fr 2fr and two 20px gaps, the simplified leftover-space calculation gives 200px for 1fr and 400px for 2fr.
